current_checkpoint_note: Authenticated Real-Data Stabilisation Phase (starting SHA 833b0ed) -- a data-integrity/production-readiness pass, not a feature build, investigating the product owner's real report: 'sign in successfully, but many screens do not fully load the farm data' on mobile. Real Supabase CLI access to Farm Return V1 Dev (linked, read-only) confirmed the real authenticated Dev farm ('KC'): 1 farm, onboarding complete, 1 mapped field (0.62ha, real P/K Index), 1 livestock group (20 suckler cows, grazing), 0 housing/soil tests/slurry/job sessions/decisions/jobs. Ruled out directly: Supabase cookie secure-flag, proxy.ts redirect behaviour, Mapbox token referrer restriction (tested with three different Referer headers against the real token), geolocation crash risk (already defensively guarded). Fixed defensively: next.config.ts now sets allowedDevOrigins from a real, optional DEV_LAN_IP env var (a real, confirmed-present Next 16.3.2 dev-mode cross-origin protection, not empirically triggered this session but real in the installed source). Full account: docs/real-data/HOSTING_DIAGNOSIS.md.
